faqs.question: How do I start farming aura?
faqs.answer: Simply use the /start command in any channel where Aurix is active. The more you interact, the more aura you accumulate!

faqs.question: Can I use Aurix on my own server?
faqs.answer: Yes! Click the Add Bot to Your Server button and authorize Aurix. You'll have full access to all features.

faqs.question: What are the rewards for ranking up?
faqs.answer: Higher ranks unlock exclusive roles, badges, bonus aura multipliers, and access to premium competitions.

faqs.question: How often does the leaderboard reset?
faqs.answer: The global leaderboard resets monthly, while seasonal leaderboards reset quarterly. Your stats are always preserved!

faqs.question: Is Aurix free to use?
faqs.answer: Yes, Aurix has free core features. Premium plans add stronger boosts and bonus rewards for players who want to progress faster.

faqs.question: How can I report bugs or suggest features?
faqs.answer: Join our official Discord server and use the #suggestions and #bug-reports channels. We read and respond to all feedback!
